_parked: PARKED TYPE (2026-08-27, owner order). A order is RECORDED, not PROCESSED. This fixture previously specified a full 11-step extraction pipeline; that was never implemented and is now explicitly NOT the contract. Base extraction resolves COMPANY_ID / TYPE / DOC_DATE and the lane does nothing else: no per-type extraction, no selection, no ERP priority sync.

router._note: ONE executable action. The driver drops every ACTION beginning 'no_action' before dispatch (indoxV2Driver01 :: 'If Action'), so no_action_already_completed and no_action_merged are inert verdicts that never reach the router. There is no restart_* action and none is needed: ACTION_RESTART != 'COMPLETED', so the lane answers mark_completed and the row lands.

kw_extract._note: none — the lane runs no per-type extraction.

ai_extract._note: AI_TYPE only, from the shared BASE extractor (indoxV2ExtractInvoiceGemini01). No per-type AI call.

select._note: none — SelectType01 never runs for a parked type.

sync._note: NEVER posted to the client's ERP. That is the point of parking it.
